content: Amsagar n Dawud ak-d Ṣiba

Umi iɛdu Dawud cwayt x tqiccet n wedrar, iffeɣ Ṣiba, amsexxar n Mafibucat, i umsagar akides s ict n tyuya n yeɣyař bardɛen, issars xasen mitayen n iɣrumen, mya n iɣrumen n zzbib u mya n tini n unebdu d ict n tecyart dayes binu.

Inna ujeǧid i Ṣiba: “Min texsed ad tegged s uya?” Inna Ṣiba: “Iɣyař i taddart n ujeǧid ḥima ad xasen nyen, u aɣrum d tini n unebdu i imsexxaren, ḥima ad ccen, u binu i yinni yuḥřen di řexřa, ḥima ad swen.”
Xenni inna ujeǧid: “Mani iǧa mmis n sidi nnec?” Inna Ṣiba i ujeǧid: “Xzar, netta iqqim di Urcalim, maɣar netta inna: ‘Ass-a taddart n Israil ad ayi dd-tarr tageldit n baba.’”
Xenni inna ujeǧid i Ṣiba: “Xzar, marra min iǧan n Mafibucat, ad yiři nnec!” Ṣiba inna: “Necc bendqeɣ, mři ufiɣ arḍa di tiṭṭawin nnec, a sidi inu ajeǧid!”
Dawud ittwanɛeř zi Cimɛi
Umi dd-yusa ujeǧid Dawud ɣar Baxurim, iẓra ijj n weryaz iffeɣ-dd ssenni zi řaǧ n taddart n Cawul. Qqaren as Cimɛi, mmis n Jira. Netta iggur am ineɛɛeř.
Netta iḥejjar Dawud d marra imsexxaren n ujeǧid Dawud s yeẓra, am ibedd řgens marra d marra ayt n bu-teɣruḍt zzates ɣar yefus d uzeřmaḍ.
Ammu i iqqar Cimɛi am t ineɛɛeř: “Aggʷej, aggʷej, cek, aryaz n usizzeř n idammen d weryaz i war isekkwin!

SIDI issiweḍ xak marra idammen n taddart n Cawul wenni deg wemcan nnes i tḥekmed. SIDI iwca tageldit deg ifassen n mmic Abcalum. Xzar man aya iffeɣ-dd zi tuɛeffna nnec umi cek d ijj n weryaz n usizzeř n idammen.”
Xenni inna Abicay, mmis n Ṣaruya, i ujeǧid: “Mayemmi ɣa inɛeř weqzin-a immuten, sidi inu ajeǧid? Ejj ayi ad din ẓwiɣ, ad as qesseɣ azeǧif.”
Maca ajeǧid inna: “Min din jar ayi d kenniw, arraw n Ṣaruya? Aqa netta inɛeř, umi d as inna SIDI: ‘Nɛeř Dawud!’ Man wen izemmaren xenni ad yini: ‘Mayemmi i teggid aya?’”
Dawud yarni inna i Abicay d marra imsexxaren nnes: “Xzarem, mmi i dd-iffɣen zi ddat inu, yarezzu ad ayi ineɣ. Mahu xenni řexxu aryaz-a zeg ayt n Binyamin? Jjem t ad inɛeř, minzi SIDI i d as t innan.
Ad taɣ SIDI ad ittwařa tamara inu uca ad ayi dd-yarr SIDI taṣebḥant deg wemcan n nneɛřet nnes n wass-a.”
Dawud ak-d yeryazen nnes ṭṭfen abrid u Cimɛi yuyur arendad nnes ɣar uɣezdis nneɣni n tewrirt, am ineɛɛeř u ittḥejjar Dawud s yeẓra uca igga taɛejjajt ad tḍuw.
Yiweḍ-dd ujeǧid ak-d marra řgens i ɣares ɣar Ayafim. Dinni izemmar ad yarr nnefs ɛawed.
Ḥucay d Axitufil ak-d Abcalum
Abcalum ak-d marra řgens, iryazen n Israil, usin-dd ɣar Urcalim u Axitufil tuɣa-t ɣares.
Umi i dd-yusa Ḥucay, Ayarki, ameddukkeř n Dawud, ɣar Abcalum, imsar belli Ḥucay inna i Abcalum: “Tudart i ujeǧid, tudart i ujeǧid!”
Abcalum inna i Ḥucay: “Ma d man aya xenni d ijj n wescan n tmexsiwt icewwaren i umeddukkeř nnec? Mayemmi war triḥed ak-d umeddukkeř nnec?”
Ḥucay inna i Abcalum: “Lla, necc ad iřiɣ ɣar wenni ittwafarzen zi SIDI u zi marra řgens-a u zi marra iryazen n Israil, u necc ad ɣares qqimeɣ.
I umi ɣa sexxareɣ xenni? Ma war ittiři zzat i wudem n mmis? Am mammec necc xedmeɣ zzat i wudem n babac, ammu i ɣa iřiɣ zzat i wudem nnec.”
Abcalum inna i Axitufil: “Wcem aneɣ ccwar, min ɣa negg?”

Axitufil inna i Abcalum: “Adef ɣar tiyya n babac tinni ijja awarni as ḥima ad ḥḍant taddart. Ammu i ɣa iseř marra Israil, aqa cek tessarzged ixef nnec ɣar babac uca ad ttwassjehden ifassen n marra inni akidek iǧan.”
Wtin i Abcalum ict n tqiḍunt x tzeqqa u Abcalum yudef ɣar tiyya n babas zzat i tiṭṭawin n marra Israil.
Deg wussan nni ittwaḥseb ccwar n Axitufil axmi ijjen yarezzu awař n AREBBI. Ammu i yeǧa s marra ccwar n Axitufil, am ɣar Dawud am ɣar Abcalum.
